# Card canonical query (Red)

## Scope

`GET` in `src/app/card/route.tsx` renders the 1200x630 PNG share card from `t` (run token) or `b` (builder token), with optional `pack` and `mirror` (`mirror` defaults on and `mirror=0` turns it off). Before this change, any extra, duplicate, default, unknown, or reordered query parameter produced a distinct CDN cache key and triggered a fresh card render.

Across `src/`, `git grep -n "/card" src/` confirms that `cardHref` (`src/components/share/download.ts:17-22`, called by `downloadCard` at `src/components/share/download.ts:82-89` and `useCardDownload` at `src/components/share/useCardDownload.ts:48, 69`) is the only `/card` URL builder in the application. Open Graph metadata in `runMetadata` (`src/app/r/[token]/title.ts:22`) and `Image` (`src/app/r/[token]/opengraph-image.tsx:11`) use `/r/${encodeURIComponent(token)}/opengraph-image`, not `/card`. `src/passcode.ts` and `src/proxy.ts` are untouched.

At commit `dabf17bc` (`/Users/paulo/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/432c72be-fea7-4e5b-a536-fe1d5f75a56a/scratch/logs/7cq/vitest-green.log`), all 49 tests across `src/components/share/__tests__/download.test.ts` (27) and `src/app/card/__tests__/route.test.ts` (22) pass.

## Decisions

- **Pure helper in `src/components/share/card-query.ts` (`principle-boundary-discipline`, `principle-model-the-domain`, `principle-laziness-protocol`).** `canonicalCardQuery(q: URLSearchParams)` (`src/components/share/card-query.ts:3-14`) encodes the canonical `/card` query rules in one pure function, re-exported from `src/components/share/download.ts:5` and called by both `cardHref` (`src/components/share/download.ts:17-22`) and `GET` (`src/app/card/route.tsx:9-38`). Placing `canonicalCardQuery` in `src/components/share/card-query.ts` instead of importing `src/components/share/download.ts` into `src/app/card/route.tsx` keeps `src/images/settings.ts:1` (`useSyncExternalStore` from `"react"`) out of the App Route module graph during `next build`.
- **Token precedence and missing or empty tokens (`principle-boundary-discipline`).** When both `t` and `b` have non-empty values, `t` wins (`const out = t ? new URLSearchParams({ t }) : b ? new URLSearchParams({ b }) : null` at `src/components/share/card-query.ts:6`), matching the route's prior `t`-first behavior (`src/app/card/__tests__/route.test.ts:111-112`). When only one of `t` or `b` has a non-empty value (such as `t=&b=pd1.xyz` at `src/components/share/__tests__/download.test.ts:59`), that non-empty token is used. When neither `t` nor `b` has a non-empty value (`/card`, `/card?t=`, `/card?b=`, `/card?t=&b=`, `/card?t=&utm=1`), `canonicalCardQuery` returns `null` and `GET` (`src/app/card/route.tsx:12-17`) returns `400` `"Bad or missing run token."` with `"cache-control": "no-store"` instead of redirecting (`src/app/card/__tests__/route.test.ts:141-152`).
- **Pack and mirror normalization (`principle-model-the-domain`).** `canonicalCardQuery` (`src/components/share/card-query.ts:8-12`) appends `pack` after `t` or `b` only when `pack !== null && pack !== DEFAULT_PACK_ID && packById(pack) !== null` (where `DEFAULT_PACK_ID` is `"pokeapi-pixel"` and `"pokeapi-art"` is the non-default pack in `src/data/image-packs.json:2-39` and `src/images/packs.ts:37-41`), and appends `mirror=0` last only when `q.get("mirror") === "0"`. `cardHref` (`src/components/share/download.ts:17-22`) passes its `URLSearchParams` through `canonicalCardQuery` so the client never emits a default or unknown `pack` that the route would redirect (`src/components/share/__tests__/download.test.ts:21-45`).
- **Relative `Location` header, `308` status, and `CARD_CACHE_CONTROL` (`principle-boundary-discipline`).** `NextResponse.redirect(url, init)` (`node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/response.js:94-107`) calls `validateURL(url)` (`node_modules/next/dist/server/web/utils.js:125-133`), which parses `new URL(String(url))` and requires an absolute URL. By contrast, `GET` in `src/app/card/route.tsx:18-23` returns `new Response(null, { status: 308, headers: { location: `/card?${canonical}`, "cache-control": CARD_CACHE_CONTROL } })`, which `sendResponse` (`node_modules/next/dist/server/send-response.js:35-54`) writes directly to the HTTP response. Using a relative `Location` (`/card?${canonical}`) keeps cached redirects independent of the request origin or `Host` header, and reusing `CARD_CACHE_CONTROL` (`"public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=31536000"` from `src/components/share/card-images.ts:113`) lets browsers keep the pure redirect for 1 day and the per-deployment CDN cache keep it for 1 year. Because the `308` check runs before `cardModel` and `cardImages` (`src/app/card/route.tsx:18-26`), non-canonical queries do not replay the engine or render an image.
- **Idempotent serialization comparison (`principle-make-operations-idempotent`, `principle-test-behavior-not-implementation`).** `canonicalCardQuery` serializes parameters via `URLSearchParams.prototype.toString()`, and `GET` (`src/app/card/route.tsx:18`) checks `request.nextUrl.search !== `?${canonical}`` (`NextURL.prototype.search` delegates to `URL.prototype.search` at `node_modules/next/dist/server/web/next-url.js:144-146`). Because `URL.prototype.search` preserves the ASCII output of `URLSearchParams.prototype.toString()` unchanged, requesting `/card?${canonical}` satisfies `request.nextUrl.search === `?${canonical}`` on the redirected request and renders `200` `image/png` without looping (`src/app/card/__tests__/route.test.ts:128-139`).
